5.keywords: 10 VPCs on one DX = single point of failure; evaluating VPN as backup; MOST cost-effective
5.trap: MPLS can't connect directly to VPCs — needs colocation at a DX location anyway; far pricier than VPN
5.rule: Cheapest DX backup → Site-to-Site VPN to each VGW (BGP prefers DX, fails over to VPN). Second DX = max resilience, not cheapest.

36.keywords: encrypt laptop→VPC traffic; keep DX consistent performance
36.trap: Private VIF can't carry the VPN — VPN endpoints are AWS public IPs
36.rule: IPsec VPN over Direct Connect → PUBLIC VIF + Site-to-Site VPN to the VGW (or Transit VIF + TGW private IP VPN).

27.keywords: ~50 accounts; central team owns all domains; share private DNS across VPCs in different accounts; LEAST complex
27.trap: Private hosted zones can't be delegated via NS records to another account's zone — names won't resolve
27.rule: Cross-account private DNS → one PHZ in the central account + programmatically associate other accounts' VPCs (create-vpc-association-authorization + associate-vpc-with-hosted-zone).

61.keywords: Fargate in private subnet, no outside connection; CannotPullContainerError to ECR
61.trap: Public IP is useless without an IGW; ECR needs INTERFACE endpoints (ecr.api + ecr.dkr) + S3 gateway endpoint, not a single gateway endpoint
61.rule: Private Fargate can't pull images → NAT gateway in the PUBLIC subnet + private route 0.0.0.0/0 → NAT (or ECR interface endpoints + S3 gateway endpoint).

68.keywords: e-commerce on Fargate + ALB + CloudFront; prevent DNS spoofing / SSL hijacking; MOST secure
68.trap: No need for a third-party DNS provider or bought certificate — Route 53 signs DNSSEC natively and ACM issues free certs
68.rule: Anti-MITM → Route 53 DNSSEC signing on the public hosted zone + ACM cert on the ALB + CloudFront HTTP→HTTPS redirect.

22.keywords: port scans from one IP; block IP immediately; protect from network/transport-layer (L3/L4) DDoS
22.trap: Per-instance Windows Firewall doesn't scale; GuardDuty detects, doesn't block or stop DDoS
22.rule: Block an IP → NACL deny (SGs have no deny). L3/L4 DDoS protection → AWS Shield (Advanced for extra protection + DRT).

47.keywords: SSL private key must never leave; logs durable + only authorized decrypt; MOST highly available
47.trap: Picked CloudHSM without multi-AZ — one HSM = single point of failure
47.rule: Keys never leave + HA → CloudHSM cluster across ≥2 AZs, TCP (L4) LB pass-through, logs to S3 with SSE.

74.keywords: 🔁 ECS Fargate env vars; credentials not visible on cluster; lifecycle management + KEY ROTATION; least effort
74.trap: 🔁 Same pick as the chapter drill: Parameter Store has no built-in rotation or lifecycle
74.rule: 'Rotation' or 'lifecycle' in the question → Secrets Manager; reference it in the task definition `secrets` + task execution role.

12.keywords: 🔁 latest patches; check approved AMIs; must NOT block devs, just notify (Select TWO)
12.trap: GuardDuty = threat detection; it checks neither patches nor AMIs. (Drill pick was C,D — this time D was dropped)
12.rule: Patching → SSM Patch Manager baseline. 'Detect but don't block' → AWS Config managed rule `approved-amis-by-id` (not IAM or SCP deny).

13.keywords: hundreds of Windows EC2; auto-patch; reboots must NOT happen at the same time
13.trap: One patch group plus a CloudWatch cron patches everything at once and bypasses Maintenance Windows
13.rule: Staggered patch reboots → 2+ patch groups (tags) + non-overlapping Maintenance Windows running AWS-RunPatchBaseline.

53.keywords: patch all envs EXCEPT prod; each env different baseline; least effort
53.trap: Tagging by OS only → can't tell environments apart, so prod can't be excluded
53.rule: Per-environment patching → tag by environment + OS, one patch baseline per env, Patch Groups, Maintenance Windows.

73.keywords: 🔁 new version marked unhealthy; ASG terminates before you can log in; quickest troubleshoot
73.trap: 🔁 Same pick as the chapter drill: verbose logging doesn't stop the ASG from terminating the instance
73.rule: Keep unhealthy instances alive to debug → suspend the ASG 'Terminate' process (or lifecycle hook / standby), then Session Manager.

28.keywords: share resources via RAM with org accounts; service acts on moderator's behalf; simple
28.trap: 'Cross-account access' isn't a RAM feature — the actual mechanism is trusted access
28.rule: RAM + Organizations → enable trusted access (`aws ram enable-sharing-with-aws-organization`).

40.keywords: root SCP blocks Config changes; acquired account can't apply Config rules; no long-term overhead
40.trap: Removing the root restriction lets EVERY account change Config; an onboarding OU alone still inherits the root deny
40.rule: Deny at root blocks all OUs → move SCPs from root to the Production OU + temporary Onboarding OU for new accounts.

55.keywords: partner frequently downloads from startup's S3; lower startup's data transfer cost
55.trap: s3 sync still charges transfer out + extra storage; cross-account GET is billed to the bucket owner
55.rule: Make downloaders pay → S3 Requester Pays.

10.keywords: RTO < 3h, RPO 15 min; cheaper than pilot light; discover PII
10.trap: 15-min backups to Glacier: retrieval time + restore risks RTO, and frequent Glacier writes aren't cheap
10.rule: Backup & restore DR → hourly DB backups to S3 + transaction logs every 5 min (meets RPO). PII discovery → Macie (Shield = DDoS).

14.keywords: fault tolerant to Region failure; writes HA in one Region; reads multi-Region; relational (Select TWO)
14.trap: Cross-Region replication can't sync two RDS MySQL writers; Multi-AZ doesn't survive a Region failure
14.rule: Multi-Region relational reads + single-Region writes → Aurora Global Database + Route 53 geolocation + failover records.

17.keywords: SAM serverless app; slow logins + occasional 504; minimal cost (Select TWO)
17.trap: Deploying the app to multiple Regions is costly; max-age caching doesn't help dynamic login requests
17.rule: Slow auth + 504 at CloudFront → Lambda@Edge for auth near users + origin failover (origin group).

25.keywords: DB CPU high → health check page queries DB → ASG replaces healthy instances (Select TWO)
25.trap: RDS MySQL has no single reader endpoint (that's Aurora); a TCP check doesn't validate the web app at all
25.rule: Decouple ALB health check from DB (simple HTML page) + reduce DB load with ElastiCache.

64.keywords: 🔁 Lambda 4.5 min mostly waiting on on-prem MySQL; costs exploding; reduce overall cost
64.trap: 🔁 Same pick as the chapter drill: CloudFront in front of API Gateway + DAX add new paid services; API Gateway has built-in caching
64.rule: Reduce Lambda invocations cheaply → API Gateway caching. Cut wait time → move DB to RDS, then right-size Lambda timeout/memory.

21.keywords: millions of views of static content; users store photos + 100-char captions; auto scale
21.trap: SAML 2.0 is not how social IdPs (Google/Facebook) sign in; RDS scales worse than DynamoDB for simple items
21.rule: Mobile app + social login + massive scale → Cognito + DynamoDB + S3 + CloudFront.

65.keywords: ReactJS SPA; store caption in DynamoDB; no big spikes; most cost-effective + scalable
65.trap: NGINX on EC2 + ALB + ASG costs more than static hosting; no STS temporary creds
65.rule: SPA + DynamoDB → S3 static website + web identity federation (AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity) → IAM role scoped to DynamoDB/S3.

72.keywords: stats reports read by millions daily; durable, HA, scalable; most cost-effective
72.trap: ElastiCache with default expiry = extra cluster cost; still hits DB for every miss
72.rule: Read-heavy, daily-changing reports → batch-generate to S3 + CloudFront with daily TTL (read replicas feed the batch).

69.keywords: batch image jobs; exceed capacity; least management overhead; keep durability; cost-effective
69.trap: SQS + Spot ASG = DIY scheduler; EFS costs more than S3; Spot interruptions can cause double processing
69.rule: Batch jobs + least overhead → AWS Batch managed compute env with Spot + S3 for raw/processed data.

62.keywords: call center self-service; ASR + natural language; query business apps
62.trap: MediaConnect = live video transport; Polly = text-to-speech, not speech recognition
62.rule: Contact center → Amazon Connect; conversational bot with ASR/NLU → Amazon Lex (+ Lambda to query backends).

57.keywords: facial recognition over video archive; later full migration; minimal disruption + least ops
57.trap: Tape gateway → Glacier: Rekognition can't read video from virtual tapes
57.rule: Hybrid media + ML → File Gateway (NFS/SMB → S3) + Rekognition face collection via Lambda.

26.keywords: single NGINX + MySQL on Fedora; must use ELB + Route 53; most efficient
26.trap: Option contradicts itself ('Multi-AZ RDS in one AZ only') and imports a stale backup instead of migrating live data
26.rule: Read every step: reject options with internal contradictions. Simple web + DB → EC2 in 2 AZs + DMS + ELB + Route 53 alias.

29.keywords: import VMs; sync changes until cutover; minimal downtime; TBs of root + data volumes; minimal overhead
29.trap: Scheduled VM Import/Export scripts = high overhead and no continuous sync
29.rule: Continuous block-level replication + short cutover → AWS MGN (Replication Agent, test launch, cutover).

42.keywords: DW → Redshift; 30-day window; only 50 Mbps; daily increments; cost-effective
42.trap: Pointless Oracle RDS hop + copying daily updates over the internet
42.rule: Bulk offline load (Data Transfer Terminal/Snowball) + SCT for schema + DMS ongoing replication (CDC) for the increments.

1.keywords: least privilege; SGs + network monitoring at container level
1.watch: bridge/host mode can't attach SGs per task
1.rule: Per-task SG + ENI → awsvpc mode + IAM task roles.

2.keywords: several deploys/day; OS patches within 48h; cost-effective
2.watch: Linked to Q13/Q53 (patch groups) — patching is your weak side
2.rule: Immutable patching → SSM builds patched AMI → replace ASG instances; app via CodeDeploy.

3.watch: Public hosted zone exposes the name
3.rule: Internal-only name → Route 53 private hosted zone associated with the VPCs.

4.keywords: cron script per day; process ASAP; least effort
4.rule: Process on upload → S3 event notification → Lambda.

6.keywords: move to OpenJDK; no major app changes
6.rule: Swap runtime, keep app → replatform (containers on ECS + managed DB).

7.keywords: all Regions; EC2/IAM/RDS changes; log integrity + confidentiality
7.watch: IAM events need global services option
7.rule: CloudTrail multi-Region + global services + KMS + MFA Delete + log file validation.

8.keywords: on-prem + Fargate same cluster; consistent tooling
8.rule: Hybrid ECS on-prem + AWS → ECS Anywhere.

9.keywords: S3 website endpoint; users see nothing
9.rule: S3 website 403 → bucket needs public read (bucket policy + Block Public Access off).

11.keywords: 4 KB prefs; 3M users; social login; HA + cheap
11.watch: Same concept you missed in Q65/Q21 — web identity federation
11.rule: Per-user data + social login → DynamoDB + web identity federation (STS) + fine-grained IAM.

15.keywords: notify at quota threshold; operationally efficient
15.watch: Trusted Advisor checks fewer quotas + needs polling
15.rule: Quota alarm → CloudWatch AWS/Usage + SERVICE_QUOTA() math expression + SNS.

16.keywords: multi-Region transactions; Keyspaces too much effort
16.rule: Multi-Region active-active NoSQL → DynamoDB global tables.

18.watch: Visibility timeout also plausible — read which symptom
18.rule: Messages hit DLQ too early → raise redrive maxReceiveCount.

19.keywords: keep user perms (no role switch); audit policies
19.watch: Role assumption gives up user perms
19.rule: Cross-account without giving up perms → resource-based policy + Config rules to audit.

20.keywords: collect + analyze EC2 logs; minimal effort
20.rule: EC2 logs → unified CloudWatch agent + Logs Insights.

23.keywords: protect credit card field; raise cache hit ratio
23.watch: max-age only helps cacheable static content (it was a distractor in Q17)
23.rule: Sensitive form field → CloudFront field-level encryption + HTTPS to origin; hit ratio → Cache-Control max-age.

24.watch: Unified CloudWatch agent works on-prem too
24.rule: Logs → CloudWatch agent → metric filter → alarm → SNS.

30.keywords: OCR license expiring; scalable, durable, HA
30.watch: EC2 OCR software = keep license problem
30.rule: Images → S3 + CloudFront; OCR → Textract; web → Elastic Beanstalk multi-AZ.

31.rule: CloudFormation stack: multi-AZ ASG + ALB + Aurora MySQL.

32.watch: Route 53 failover records fail back automatically when primary is healthy
32.rule: Warm standby: StackSets in both Regions + S3 CRR + Route 53 failover routing.

33.keywords: EKS steady + unpredictable peaks; minimize compute cost
33.watch: EC2 Instance Savings Plans lock to family/Region
33.rule: Baseline → Compute Savings Plans; spikes → Spot; steady DB → RI.

34.keywords: integrity of logs; account activity history

35.keywords: not over public internet; see denied source IPs
35.watch: Flow Logs capture REJECT + source IP; CloudTrail doesn't
35.rule: Private connectivity → VPC peering; denied traffic → VPC Flow Logs → CloudWatch Logs metric filter.

37.keywords: detect changes to AWS Organizations (Select TWO)
37.rule: Org change alerts → CloudTrail + EventBridge/SNS and Config + SNS/EventBridge.

38.keywords: 24×7 HPC app; data growing; most cost-effective
38.watch: All On-Demand or all Spot for a 24×7 baseline
38.rule: Steady baseline → Reserved; bursts → Auto Scaling On-Demand; shared growing data → EFS/S3.

39.keywords: map loads ~50% of time; NAT instances
39.watch: Relates to Q61: NAT GW lives in the public subnet
39.rule: Intermittent outbound failure → one NAT instance failed → NAT Gateway per AZ.

41.keywords: slow processing; EBS too small; HA + scalable storage

43.rule: Real-time streams → Kinesis Data Streams + real-time analytics dashboard.

44.keywords: keep 120 days then delete; low latency; 10–15 TB
44.watch: S3 lifecycle has higher-latency retrieval for record lookups

45.keywords: delete stack but keep RDS + S3 data
45.watch: Don't rely on defaults — set DeletionPolicy explicitly per resource
45.rule: DeletionPolicy: Snapshot for RDS, Retain for S3.

46.watch: ACM certs are Regional (except us-east-1 for CloudFront)
46.rule: New Region ALB → request ACM cert in that Region.

48.keywords: allow/deny services per account; least complexity
48.watch: IAM per account = no central control
48.rule: Restrict services per account/OU → Organizations SCPs.

50.keywords: SQL injection on API Gateway; track rule changes
50.rule: SQLi → WAF web ACL on API Gateway; change history → Config.

51.keywords: custom auth + IAM roles for AWS access (Select TWO)
51.watch: Cognito user pools not allowed here
51.rule: Custom OIDC IdP + Cognito identity pools, or custom SAML IdP (LDAP) + IAM SAML provider.

52.keywords: apex domain; multi-Region ALBs; operationally efficient
52.watch: CNAME can't be at the apex
52.rule: Static anycast IPs across Regions → Global Accelerator + Route 53 alias at the apex.

54.keywords: DB creds encrypted at rest + in transit; automated deploy
54.watch: ⚠️ Q74: when ROTATION is required → Secrets Manager, not Parameter Store
54.rule: Plain secret storage → Parameter Store SecureString + IAM role + KMS decrypt.

56.keywords: DDoS mitigation without Shield Advanced (Select TWO)
56.rule: CloudFront + ALB + WAF + Auto Scaling + CloudWatch alarms.

58.keywords: cross-account VPC can't resolve PHZ record (Select TWO)
58.watch: ⚠️ Same concept you missed in Q27
58.rule: Account A: create-vpc-association-authorization → Account B: associate-vpc-with-hosted-zone → delete authorization.

59.keywords: block sanctioned countries; low latency globally
59.rule: Country block → CloudFront geo restriction (or WAF geo match).

60.keywords: Oracle → PostgreSQL; schema + code conversion first

63.keywords: SCP denies ECS actions but still allowed
63.watch: SCPs also don't affect the management account

66.keywords: don't share RI discounts with other BUs
66.watch: RIs can't be moved between accounts
66.rule: Turn off RI/Savings Plans discount sharing for those accounts in the management account.

67.keywords: massive traffic of hi-res images; block SQLi/XSS
67.watch: WAF on CloudFront protects at the edge
67.rule: Static assets → CloudFront; common web attacks → WAF on CloudFront.

70.keywords: inter-Region VPC mesh over DX; low overhead
70.watch: ⚠️ Q36: VPN over DX needs a PUBLIC VIF; plain private access = private VIF
70.rule: Many VPCs/Regions over DX → Direct Connect Gateway + private VIF + VGW per VPC.

71.keywords: recover from AZ loss at peak; most cost-effective
71.watch: Spot diversified reduces AZ/pool interruption risk
71.rule: Peak capacity cheaply + resilient → Spot Fleet diversified allocation + Auto Scaling per AZ.

75.keywords: internal app; docs hot 3 months, retain 5 years; lowest cost
75.watch: Spot draining needed to avoid dropped tasks
75.rule: ECS on Spot (draining) + RDS RI + S3 lifecycle → Glacier.

inconsistent: Cross-account private hosted zone → VPC association authorization
Parameter Store vs Secrets Manager (rotation → Secrets Manager)
Direct Connect VIF types (private VIF vs public VIF for VPN)

SCP inheritance from root → OU placement
